subject: general
question: Which Amendment of the Constitution of India envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System to perform functions and powers entrusted to it by the State Legislatures?
solution:
The correct answer is __**73rd**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 73rd Amendment** of the Constitution of India envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System.
 
• This amendment was enacted in **1992** and came into effect on **24th April 1993**.
 
• It added **Part IX** to the Constitution, titled "The Panchayats", and consists of provisions from **Article 243 to Article 243O**.
 
• The amendment aims to provide constitutional status to the Panchayati Raj institutions and ensure more participation of people in the administration of local affairs.
 
• The Gram Sabha is entrusted with powers and functions by the state legislatures to ensure effective governance at the grassroots level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule **of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The 73rd Amendment has played a significant role in empowering local governance and decentralizing administration in India.
